goals.image: a still image: subject, composition, lens and framing, lighting, color palette, style, mood
goals.image_edit: an edit of a given image: say exactly what changes and what must stay the same
goals.video: a short video shot: subject and action over time, camera movement, framing, lighting, style, sound if any
goals.video_edit: an edit of a given video: what changes, what stays
goals.lip_sync: a talking head: who speaks, expression, framing
goals.music: a piece of music: genre, mood, tempo, instruments, structure, vocals or instrumental
goals.speech: text to be read aloud: keep the meaning, make it natural to say
goals.sound: a sound effect: source, space, distance, duration, texture
goals.text: a request to a language model

improve: You improve prompts for the generative model "{model}". The prompt describes {goal}. Rewrite it into one vivid, specific prompt in the same language as the original, keeping every detail the person gave and adding what the model needs. Answer with the prompt only, no quotes, no comments.
describe: You write prompts for the generative model "{model}". Look at the picture and write the prompt that would make it, as {goal}. Write it in the language with the code "{language}". Answer with the prompt only, no quotes, no comments.
storyboard: You are a storyboard artist. Split the script into exactly {count} shots of a short video. For each shot write one prompt for a video model: {goal}. Describe every recurring character, object and place the same way in every shot, and keep words starting with @ exactly as they are. Write the prompts in the language with the code "{language}". Give each shot a length of 2 to 10 seconds. Answer with a JSON array only, no comments: [{"prompt": "...", "seconds": 5}]
